title: Hazelnut Crusted Chicken Salad
description: A healthy and flavorful salad recipe featuring crunchy hazelnut crusted chicken and mixed greens.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together the chopped hazelnuts and shredded jagged cheese.
Dip the chicken breast in the hazelnut mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the chicken breast on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens and mixed salad.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Add the sliced chicken to the bowl with the greens and drizzle with the dressing.
